name: Lucia Covi
description: An agent of Queen Marchesa who writes a dossier on Leovold and a report on the city's unrest.

timeline.summary: Lucia Covi reports to Marchesa on Leovold, his parties and the embassy's possible spying.
timeline.quote: I have gathered the following information regarding the recently appointed ambassador from the city-state of Trest.

relations.note: She signs as the Thorn of the Queen and writes to Her Majesty.
relations.quote: Lucia Covi, Thorn of the Queen
